lessons: Check whether the style is fixed or comes from a per-user profile file (voice file, about-me file). Consistent tone, rhythm, hook and CTA across outputs may be one instance of a configurable voice. Recover the dimensions it controls, not only the observed values.

Captured outputs drop the packaging around the deliverable: code-block wrapping, a rationale note after the draft, notes kept apart from paste-ready copy. Always ask what surrounds the artifact when it is handed over.

An absent feature (no hashtags, no engagement bait, US vs British spelling) is often a conditional default with an override, not an absolute ban. Phrase recovered bans as defaults and ask what overrides them.

When outputs fall into a few distinct shapes, look for a user-selected framework menu (PAS, how-to, story, contrarian) instead of writing one conditional per brief type. Treat observed length ranges as a floor for the real limits; stated ranges are usually wider.
